experiments/learner/checkpoints.py.reason: Additive v7 native-opponent optimizer provenance; original policy/model path retained

execution.comparison_scope: Two matched engine/policy-seed and seat pairs; separate training seeds. Nullkiller randomness is not fully seed-reproducible. This tiny sample cannot establish strategic improvement.
execution.wall_scope: One shared 3600-second clock includes initialization, all games, audits/replay, one update, checkpoint verification and cleanup. After evaluations have the final 600 seconds, with the last 60 seconds reserved for cleanup/reporting.

limitations: One update and two matched evaluations per phase cannot establish a learning trend or improved strategy.
All eight outcomes were learner losses; no learner win was observed.
Native opponent decisions have additional randomness, so paired engine seeds do not promise identical opponent behavior.
Raw captures, checkpoints and original game assets remain ignored and local.
This offline evidence assembly only reads saved files and tensors; it launches no game, replay, model forward pass or optimizer.
